The Trump administration’s counterterrorism strategy is now targeting trans rights groups, meanwhile it makes no mention of right-wing extremism.

Ridiculous is an understatement. The fact is that trans people are far more likely to be the victims of crime than the perpetrators of it.
advocate.com/politics/nation…

Small businesses lost 4.5x MORE jobs in 2025 than during the pandemic in 2020.

Republicans are working for their billionaire buddies, not small business owners.

ACLU attorney Emi MacLean is fighting for TPS holders at the Supreme Court. 

Listen to her call for Congress to urgently protect TPS from this administration’s actions:

Video

The Virginia Supreme Court just overturned the new congressional maps that voters in Virginia approved.

The American people are already losing trust in the courts, and this total violation of the will of the people will only make more lose faith.

Trump’s attacks on civil rights and DEI don’t just harm minority communities — they hurt us all.

Diversity makes us all stronger.

Video

Trump’s countless actions rolling back civil rights were all part of his Project 2025 plan. 

From restricting voting rights to his anti DEI policies, we must urgently reverse these policies as soon as we get the gavels back.

Video

Even @WSJ is debunking Trump’s economic arguments for his mass deportation campaign:

-Employment among US-born men FELL in areas with more ICE arrests.
-Deporting law-abiding immigrant workers REDUCES job opportunities for American workers and is BAD for the economy. wsj.com/opinion/mass-deporta…

The national average gas price is now $4.56/gallon. That’s a 66% increase since December.

Trump did this. And Republicans in Congress let him.

Internal ICE records reveal a rise in the use of force in detention centers under Trump.

ICE agents are operating with impunity. We need to dismantle this agency and get accountability for the cruelty and pain they’ve inflicted on people across this country.

📸Shuran Huang

Read more here: marieclaire.com/politics/con…

I’m so proud to be part of the amazing group of women standing with @RepLaMonica.

Trump’s Department of Justice is politically targeting Rep. McIver because she conducted congressional oversight of a detention facility. This is intimidation — it won’t work.

Yesterday, I talked with @KUOW about the Iran war, ICE funding, and many of the ongoing fights in Congress.

Listen to the full conversation here: kuow.org/stories/rep-jayapal…

Republicans would rather give billions more to ICE and CBP than do anything to lower the cost of your healthcare, gas, or groceries.

Video

This National Small Business Week, as Trump gives tax breaks to billionaire corporations and slashes funding for small businesses, shop small and shop local!

It is critical that we support and celebrate the businesses that shape our communities.

I just toured Lumen Field to see the preparations for the World Cup!

Seattle is SO excited to welcome people across the globe to our beautiful city for this tournament.

Video

Today, a $920 MILLION bet was placed just 70 minutes before news broke of the US and Iran nearing a deal.

We’ve now seen a pattern of perfectly timed bets right before the Trump administration makes news about the war. Someone is raking it in big — this reeks of corruption. businessinsider.com/oil-us-i…
Breaking news: Members of Congress meet with ambassadors of other countries every day. That’s literally our right and responsibility.

I visited @OSLServes, an organization fighting hunger, to discuss their work serving nutritious meals to thousands across our community. 

Trump and Republicans have slashed food assistance, but thanks to the work of groups like OSL, our neighbors are able to put food on the table.

Yesterday, I toured the Smith Cove Blue Carbon project to see the work that @PortofSeattle is doing to slow ocean acidification, which threatens marine life in the Puget Sound.

This is innovative work — transplanting kelp and eelgrass to absorb carbon pollution and reestablishing native oysters to filter the water — to combat the climate crisis here in Seattle.

Hundreds of people came out for a Climate Town Hall, hosted by @ActOnClimateUS, to share their thoughts and discuss how we can fight forward to protect our communities and our planet. 

The climate crisis is here and now, and we won’t stop fighting.
